name: 5-DBFPV
summary: Stimulant of the cathinone class. Analogue of MDPV where the methylenedioxyphenyl group was replaced with a dihydrobenzofuran.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: 5-DBFPV (also known as 5-dihydrobenzofuranpyrovalerone and 3-desoxy-MDPV) is a stimulant of the cathinone class that has been sold online as a designer drug.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Like MDPV, it is thought to block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。一般認為它和MDPV一樣，會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。一般认为它和MDPV一样，会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the α-pyrrolidinophenones such as α-PVP, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, insomnia, agitation, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include psychosis, violent agitation, heart problems, seizures and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮類藥物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、失眠、躁動、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括精神病、激烈躁動、心臟問題、癲癇發作與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮类药物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、失眠、躁动、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括精神病、激烈躁动、心脏问题、癫痫发作与成瘾。

fact.en: It is MDPV with the methylenedioxy ring swapped for a dihydrobenzofuran ring, which is why it is also called 3-desoxy-MDPV: one oxygen atom has been dropped.
fact.zh: 它是把MDPV的亞甲二氧基環換成二氫苯并呋喃環，因此也被稱為3-desoxy-MDPV：少了一個氧原子。
fact.zhHans: 它是把MDPV的亚甲二氧基环换成二氢苯并呋喃环，因此也被称为3-desoxy-MDPV：少了一个氧原子。
